data.name: Mariyum
data.gender_notes: Mariyum is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mariyum is the Arabic form of Mary, referring to the mother of Jesus in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes a wished-for child. The name Mariyum carries the meaning “Bitter or Wished for” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mariyum usually hope their child will grow to embody bitter or wished for and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mariyum is a name that holds great spiritual significance in Islam, as it is the name of Maryam, the mother of Prophet Isa (Jesus).
data.etymology: Mariyum belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bitter or Wished for.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mariyum total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
